connector.name: Cloudinary Asset Management
connector.registryDescription: Upload, organize, search, and transform images, videos, and files with AI-powered tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at asset-management.mcp.cloudinary.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package asset-management-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cloudinary account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
